body: ADVISOR (01:28): YES. An ordinary trial whose oracle exits nonzero still reports its discriminating score after valid controls, flagged oracle_exit != 0 and shown in the report, consistent with the TASK-1730 exit policy. CONTROL runs stay strict: a nonzero control exit invalidates that control, so the gate refuses. A trial with nonzero exit and no parsed checks is still an error.
subject: RULING: TASK-1731 nonzero exit policy
